pages.title: Room
pages.text: A part takes one carving at the bier's first tier, two at its second, three at its third. My body carried three carvings at first. Each time I lay down and paid more, it made room for three more, up to fifteen.$(br2)Burning one away hurts. It is meant to.

pages.title: Stronger Together
pages.text: Each carving past the first makes every carving a fifth stronger. That is the corruption: it does not weaken me, it feeds them. I wear the marks on my skin now, and the veins where they meet.$(br2)Some carvings eat essence while they work. Wings eat Corruption in the air.

pages.title: What I Carved
pages.text: Night eyes, a stone shell, a deep heart. Wings of echo and wings of chain, a second leap, feet that walk on water, lava and air. Skin that hurts what strikes it. Forty and more.$(br2)The bier knows each one, and tells me what it does before the knife does.

pages.title: The Reserve
pages.text: One carving of the chest keeps essence in the body itself: the Essence Reserve, up to 1000 of each. What I kill and what I mourn goes there first. Near an awake altar it pours itself in.
